prompt: At what gross vehicle weight rating (GVWR) is a commercial driver license (CDL) required to operate a single vehicle?

options.text: Any single vehicle with a manufacturer rating of 18,001 pounds or more
Any single vehicle with a manufacturer rating of 22,001 pounds or more
Any single vehicle with a manufacturer rating of 26,001 pounds or more
Any single vehicle with a manufacturer rating of 32,001 pounds or more
